title: Edge-glyph dependence collapses at line breaks
statement: In paragraph text, the dependence between a certain word's last glyph and the next word's first glyph is at least 0.08 bits greater inside a line than across a line break (a line's last word with the next line's first word on the same page), both shuffle-corrected and measured at equal sample size, and the gap exceeds what is left when the words of each page are shuffled.
source: P-G-001 and K-001 (Rozanova and Temerev): 0.197 bits of shuffle-corrected dependence between adjacent words' edge glyphs. Registered as a target for generators: a procedure whose glyph context restarts at each line should reproduce it, one that runs through the line break should not.
